decisions.reason: After several years with little visibility, this niche hierarchical-search add-on looks like a low-upside option whose remaining functionality can be consolidated into broader offerings.
The mobile layer-control component still addresses a clear usability need in the firm's core geospatial stack and is inexpensive enough to retain as a reusable option.
As the firm's flagship GIS platform and a vehicle for its strategic direction, it remains too central to abandon absent clear evidence of failure.
The search extension is a broadly applicable complement to web-map solutions, so management would keep it while continuing to monitor overlap-driven consolidation.
